item.title: NU's Lams Lamina shines despite coming off the bench

item.title: Chezka Centeno storms into Las Vegas Open quarterfinals
item.description: MANILA, Philippines — Reigning World 10-Ball champion Chezka Centeno is on fire as she booked her spot in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Las Vegas Open being held at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort and Casino in Nevada. Centeno dominated the match, dismantling American Kennedy Mayman with a convincing 2-0 victory, securing her place in the quarterfinals of the tournament. item.title: Prosecution submits updated evidence in Duterte case at ICC
item.description: MANILA, Philippines—Prosecutors in the case against former president Rodrigo Duterte have filed a third updated list of evidence with the International Criminal Court (ICC), introducing 14 new items into the record.The submission, made public over the weekend just days before the start of the scheduled confirmation hearing on Monday, was filed in response to an order from ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I issued on Friday.
